capabilities: Write typed, signed edges with properties between notes
Define node types and schemas via frontmatter and schema notes
Run read-only openCypher queries that render as graphs or tables
Explore a full-pane graph view that follows the active note
Serve a read-only sidecar with MCP tools, vector search and GraphRAG
disambiguation: Not graph-view styling; it stores typed, signed edges with properties and answers openCypher queries over them.
extras: Directory page notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; full guide lives at typedgraph.org, and a demo vault zip is offered. Queries are read-only and the plugin states it never modifies notes.
problem: Obsidian links only say that two notes are related, not how; edges cannot carry types, signs or properties, and links cannot be queried.

relations.evidence: type:: [[Target]] {props} works like Graph Link Types, so your existing lines keep working
a drop-in replacement for lat.md that also links code into the typed graph
local vector search (Ollama), GraphRAG with citations, and an MCP server for agents
A LadybugDB mirror for full Cypher, local vector search

summary: Typed property graph over notes: typed, signed edges with properties, openCypher queries, schema notes and a separate graph view.
